FinThrive Privacy Policy

FinThrive values the privacy of personal information. As a dedicated partner to our healthcare clients, protection of protected health information (PHI) has always been a priority. However, our protection of personal information extends beyond PHI to other personal information we may obtain or collect about individuals as part of our business operations.
